title: 上班日常
description: 辦公室日常工作的常用對話

sentences.en: I usually clock in at nine.
sentences.zh: 我通常九點打卡上班。

sentences.en: Good morning! How was your commute?
sentences.zh: 早安！通勤還順利嗎？

sentences.en: I need to finish this report before the deadline.
sentences.zh: 我需要在截止日期前完成這份報告。

sentences.en: Let's grab lunch together today.
sentences.zh: 今天一起吃午餐吧。

sentences.en: I have a meeting at two o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我兩點有個會議。

sentences.en: Could you help me with this task?
sentences.zh: 你能幫我處理這個任務嗎？

sentences.en: I'm going to take a short break.
sentences.zh: 我要休息一下。

sentences.en: The printer is out of paper again.
sentences.zh: 印表機又沒紙了。

sentences.en: I'll be working overtime tonight.
sentences.zh: 我今晚要加班。

sentences.en: Can you send me that file by email?
sentences.zh: 你能用電子郵件把那個檔案寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: My colleague is on sick leave today.
sentences.zh: 我同事今天請病假。

sentences.en: I need to update my timesheet.
sentences.zh: 我需要更新我的工時表。

sentences.en: The office is really busy this week.
sentences.zh: 這週辦公室真的很忙。

sentences.en: I'm heading out for a coffee break.
sentences.zh: 我要去喝杯咖啡休息一下。

sentences.en: Do you know where the supply room is?
sentences.zh: 你知道儲物間在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: I'll clock out at six today.
sentences.zh: 我今天六點打卡下班。

sentences.en: We have a team lunch on Friday.
sentences.zh: 我們週五有團隊聚餐。

sentences.en: I forgot my badge at home.
sentences.zh: 我把識別證忘在家裡了。

sentences.en: The air conditioning is too cold in here.
sentences.zh: 這裡的冷氣太冷了。

sentences.en: I need to schedule a meeting with the client.
sentences.zh: 我需要跟客戶安排一場會議。

sentences.en: Can I use the conference room at three?
sentences.zh: 我三點可以用會議室嗎？

sentences.en: I'm swamped with work today.
sentences.zh: 我今天工作多到忙不過來。

sentences.en: Let me check my calendar.
sentences.zh: 讓我看一下我的行事曆。

sentences.en: The Wi-Fi is really slow today.
sentences.zh: 今天 Wi-Fi 真的很慢。

sentences.en: I submitted my leave request yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天提交了請假申請。

sentences.en: Who's in charge of this project?
sentences.zh: 這個專案誰負責？

sentences.en: I'll finish this before I leave.
sentences.zh: 我走之前會把這個做完。

sentences.en: Could you cover for me while I'm away?
sentences.zh: 我不在的時候你能代班嗎？

sentences.en: The boss wants to see us at four.
sentences.zh: 老闆要我們四點去見他。

sentences.en: Have a good evening! See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 晚上愉快！明天見。
